library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

# 1. Define your single center point (Latitude & Longitude)
center_lat <- 25.22073
center_lng <- -80.21036

# 2. Set box size (offset in degrees)
# ~0.001 degrees is roughly 100 meters across
box_size <- 0.0001  

# Compute opposite corners from the single point
lat1 <- center_lat + box_size
lng1 <- center_lng - box_size
lat2 <- center_lat - box_size
lng2 <- center_lng + box_size

# 3. Image and Title Setup
image_path <- "images/CFN_CE-4_2024-07-09.tif"
plot_title <- "Center Plot Location"

popup_html <- sprintf(
  "<div style='text-align: center;'>
     <h4 style='margin: 0 0 8px 0;'>%s</h4>
     <img src='%s' width='250px' style='border-radius: 6px;'/>
   </div>",
  plot_title,
  image_path
)

# 4. Render Map centered on your point
leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  setView(lng = center_lng, lat = center_lat, zoom = 17) %>%
  addRectangles(
    lng1 = lng1, lat1 = lat1,
    lng2 = lng2, lat2 = lat2,
    fillColor = "#357abd",
    fillOpacity = 0.4,
    color = "#1d4ed8",
    weight = 2,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 4,
      color = "#f59e0b",
      fillOpacity = 0.7,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    popup = popup_html
  )
